[SWS_DM_01406] Support of
SOVD
method
Delete Single Fault of an
Entity
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04259
⌈
The
Diagnostic Server instance
shall support the SOVD method
Delete
Single Fault of an Entity
if a
DiagnosticSovdFaultMemoryAccess
ref-
erences a
DiagnosticSovdMethod
and the corresponding
DiagnosticSovd-
Method.delete
attribute exists.
⌋
